intendedChanges.purpose: Expose a visible neutral report action for each rendered Partner partner-message turn and submit only identity/version metadata to the authoritative report provider.
Assert report submission payloads, current-owner/version binding, duplicate idempotency, stale/build mismatch handling, and provider failure behavior.
Move the public-package dependency contract pin to the reviewed board-facility runtime blob.

behaviorChange: The existing Partner conversation surface adds a visible report action to partner-message turns. Report submission sends no conversation text and does not alter rewards, affinity, relationship state, learning, or saves; duplicate submission remains neutral and idempotent while receipts stay authoritative-server-owned.
authorizationIntent: Use the already-merged authoritative Partner report provider to make reporting player-visible and operable on the current Browser Partner turn surface without changing partner gameplay semantics.
rollbackPlan: Revert the client report-control and test commits together; the already-merged server report provider remains backwards-compatible.
Do not touch Partner reward/affinity/save/learning state because report stays out-of-band and receipt-only.
